    vars = {}

    m.addConstr(-9.92 * vars['Var_0'] + -2.52 * vars['Var_1'] + -3.01 * vars['Var_2'] + -2.76 * vars['Var_4'] >= -43.62, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(5.49 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.96 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.9 * vars['Var_3'] + -6.4 * vars['Var_4'] >= -6.73, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(-4.77 * vars['Var_0'] + -7.91 * vars['Var_1'] + -9.16 * vars['Var_2'] + -1.55 * vars['Var_3'] + -4.23 * vars['Var_4'] >= -106.65, name='C6')
